---
mode: agent
description: Create a new reusable UI component for the Zerulean UI library
---

Create a new reusable component for this library that follows the existing patterns.

Requirements:
- Use React and TypeScript.
- Base the component on MUI primitives where appropriate.
- Keep the API ergonomic and consistent with the existing component style.
- Create or update the component folder with:
  - component implementation
  - SCSS styles
  - Storybook story
  - supporting documentation if needed
- Keep accessibility in mind and prefer semantic markup.
- Preserve the existing project conventions for naming, exports, and formatting.

When you are done, summarize:
- what changed
- how to use the component
- any follow-up recommendations
